requirement: Soft delete a clinical variable: refuse the delete while a live prerequisite formula, criterion formula, or scoring rule score function still references it, otherwise stamp IsDeleted/DeletedAt; report an unknown or already-deleted id as not found.

preconditions.text: A live clinical variable exists for the target id
Nothing live references the target variable
A live prerequisite, criterion, or scoring rule references the target
Only soft-deleted rows reference the target
The target id matches no live variable, or it is already soft-deleted

inputs.text: Delete a variable that nothing references
Second delete request for an already deleted variable
Delete a variable referenced by both a prerequisite and a criterion
Delete a variable used by a criterion formula
Delete a variable used by another variable's prerequisite
Delete a variable referenced only by soft-deleted rows
Delete a variable used inside a nested prerequisite formula
Delete a variable used by a scoring rule score function
Delete request with an unknown id

returns.text: Success with Deleted status; the variable is soft-deleted and hidden by the query filter
Unrelated variables stay live and existing deletion timestamps do not move
Failure with BusinessRuleViolation for a live prerequisite, criterion, or score function reference
Failure with BadRequest when the variable is missing or already deleted
Nothing is soft-deleted when the request is rejected

exception_text: No unhandled exception; every rejection is returned as a failed Result
